note: Frozen track registry for the NEEDLE outcome table (plan v3-jev-needle). Bindings pin the verdict docs' and receipts' BYTES as of 2026-11-11; a later legitimate amendment takes a dated additive registry amendment, never a silent re-bind (the H1/H4/H6c amendment precedent). Living ledgers (plan/*.md node records) are deliberately NOT byte-bound — they append; each track's stable docs/receipts carry the evidence. Every key number below is copied from the bound verdict doc, which re-derives it from hash-bound artifacts.

tracks.title: H1 — model-free memory consolidation
tracks.hypothesis: A model-free consolidation pass (dup merge, supersedes edges, conflict flags, reference-weighted decay) improves retrieval on the frozen 133-page corpus with zero fact loss.
tracks.criteria: Amended 2026-11-10 pre-eval (baseline falsified the original premises): no lost fact; A/B/C/D non-regression; E holds; F not worse than baseline; hygiene invariants (MEMORY.md byte-identical; archive-never-delete; receipts complete).
tracks.verdict: CONFIRMED (as amended) — value is graph hygiene + a reranker substrate, not lexical rank movement

tracks.title: H2 — bounded offline semantic rerank over FTS5 candidates
tracks.hypothesis: A deterministic GloVe mean-pool cosine rerank of the BM25 k=10 pool improves paraphrase recall (b1) and reduces negative-control false positives (f1, f3) without regressing A/C/D/E.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered contract (+ amendment 1): b1 recovered to top-5; f1/f3 measurably reduced; A/C/D/E non-regression; deterministic; rerank p95 ≤ 100 ms.
key_numbers: 3/3 both directions (shuffled weights / wrong hash / tampered artifact)
tracks.verdict: DISCONFIRMED — both arms; topical similarity cannot express absence; lexical ordering carries real fact-level signal

tracks.title: H3a — bounded semantic boost under lexical primacy
tracks.hypothesis: A bounded (BAND δ=0.10) or additive (ADD w=0.15) semantic boost over lexical scores recovers b1 while holding A/C/D/E.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered contract + amendment 1: b1 recovered; A/C/D/E non-regression; F not worse; determinism; latency budget.
key_numbers: A/C/D/E held, F no worse, but b1 rank 10 (baseline 9)
no δ lifts b1 without breaking A/D; ADD needs w > 6.3 (semantic-dominant; D 2/3 at w = 6.5)
matched observed outcomes exactly (b1 5, a1 6, d1 10)
tracks.verdict: DISCONFIRMED — the pure-rerank line closes: semantics can reorder the frozen lexical candidate set only by overriding the lexical evidence that makes the baseline good

tracks.title: H3b — lexical-evidence honesty rule
tracks.hypothesis: A lexical-evidence rule (no query content-bigram in any candidate → honest miss) suppresses negative-control false positives without false negatives.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered: suppress f1/f2/f3; zero A–E false negatives. Amendment 1 (pre-registered after L's failure, before any L2 run): L2 = L ∧ (best candidate content-token coverage < 1.0).
key_numbers: DISCONFIRMED — false negatives b1, b3, e1
f1+f3 suppressed, f2 clean, zero false negatives, zero A–E suppression
tracks.verdict: SPLIT — L DISCONFIRMED as specified; L2 CONFIRMED (single authorized refinement, validated once on the frozen 18)

tracks.title: H4 — deterministic dreaming control loop (v0)
tracks.hypothesis: A model-free trigger → Light → REM → gated Deep loop promotes H1's consolidation candidates at high precision without touching retrieval.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered DC1–DC5: orphan-link precision ≥ 0.80 and ≥ apply-all + 0.20; ≥ 15 orphans integrated; edge precision/recall ≥ 0.75; no invariant violation; retrieval non-regression.
key_numbers: 26 orphans integrated; invariants held; 18/18 non-regressed — all YES
tracks.verdict: DISCONFIRMED (v0 as specified) — the loop is safe but not selective; agreement-blindness is the measured boundary; infrastructure stays in the tree behind its gates

tracks.title: H5 — certified unlearning with tombstone ledger
tracks.hypothesis: A designated page becomes provably unretrievable (bytes, FTS5 raw tables, retrieval surface, consolidation arms) under an auditable hash-chained tombstone ledger, with a defined relearn path and no other fact lost.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered D1–D6: no admissible probe retrievable post-unlearn; no unrelated query regresses; ledger leaks no content; consolidation untouched; controls fail when they must; target separable.
key_numbers: 8/8 zero live occurrences; kb_search('fatqat') zero hits
17/17 queries exactly unchanged (ranks AND hit counts)
L1 + L2 achieved; L3 not claimed
tracks.verdict: CONFIRMED — within the pre-registered boundary (frozen corpus, easy-by-design target, one AUBench channel)

tracks.title: H6a — L2 production candidacy (fresh queries + integration)
tracks.hypothesis: The frozen L2 rule validates on fresh queries within a pre-registered envelope and can ship as an opt-in honesty layer.
tracks.criteria: Six pre-registered legs: N all suppressed; P/V zero false negatives; X matches expectations; stability on the original 18; determinism; latency budget; plus flag-off byte-identity for the integration.
key_numbers: 6/6 green — fresh 15 all pass; stability 18/18 exact
HARNESS_KB_HONESTY in kb.py, default OFF, flag-off byte-identical; 97 tests green
x1 thin-worded false-negative hole fires exactly as pre-registered
tracks.verdict: CONFIRMED — within the documented envelope; ships opt-in, default OFF

tracks.title: H6b — backflow guard at write/admission time
tracks.hypothesis: A write-time admission guard derived from H5's tombstone ledger prevents silent re-admission of a certified-forgotten fact at every repo-owned write seam while unrelated content flows.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered D1–D7 disconfirmation criteria plus E1–E7 probes: verbatim / near-verbatim / unique-literal paraphrase refused; zero blocking false positives over the corpus; relearn re-admits; corrupt ledger fails closed.
key_numbers: E1–E3, E6, E7 refused; E5 post-relearn ADMITTED; P6 untouched
0 blocking over 133 candidates (L4 demoted to advisory, pre-registered rule)
24 new + 186 existing green; 3/3 controls both directions
tracks.verdict: CONFIRMED — within the pre-registered boundary (repo-owned seams, lexical not semantic)

tracks.title: H6c — dreaming v1 (literal-local windows + stance gates + idf recalibration)
tracks.hypothesis: v1 scoring (±8-token idf-weighted windows, two-sided stance gates, BM25 idf + log authority) lifts the v0 dreaming arms past the pre-registered bars.
tracks.criteria: Pre-registered DC1–DC6: orphan P ≥ 0.80 and ≥ v0 + 0.10; orphan recall ≥ 0.50; edge P/R ≥ 0.75; invariants; retrieval non-regression; dormancy clause for the edge ceiling band.
key_numbers: P 0.80 / R 1.0 (v0 0.3636 / 1.0) — ceiling REFUTED for edges
P ≥ 0.80 only at recall ≤ 0.4878 (v0 envelope); v1 envelope worse (max 0.3171)
tracks.verdict: DISCONFIRMED overall — split outcome: edge-arm fixes work; the model-free orphan ceiling (≈ 0.60 at high recall) holds; the line goes dormant until a model-based stance check is authorized

tracks.title: v2 node-4 campaign — source-to-claim retrieval / correction / handoff qualification
tracks.hypothesis: Source-to-claim retrieval, correction and cross-session handoff can be qualified on real local content against the original 16-case acceptance input.
tracks.criteria: Original 16-case gate plus strict matched whole-usage comparison: per-case quality/scope/correction non-regression and complete aggregate token accounting.
